hooks.name: Session Report (deliver)
hooks.description: Prints target/.kiro-session-report to the agent and deletes it. UserPromptSubmit is one of the three triggers whose command stdout is forwarded, which is what makes free delivery possible: the scan runs at Stop for nothing, and its finding rides into a turn the user was starting anyway. Prints nothing when there is no report, so a clean session adds no tokens. Fails open. Logic: bin/session-report.sh.
